messages:
Nora L: hey all, quick onboarding snag. tried to enroll a passkey in Okta and the browser reports 'Registration failed: invalid response'. also accepted the Drive invite but i only see 'My Drive' and no shared drives. 1Password invite didn't come through. any pointers?
Hector (People Ops): welcome Nora! tagging IT — @Mina (IT) can you triage? also which email did you accept the invites with?
Nora L: used nora.l@redwood.ai. i'm on a corporate Win10 laptop and used Chrome.
Mina (IT): thanks. common causes: browser extensions blocking WebAuthn, or device policy blocking FIDO. can you try an incognito window first? also i'll check AD-to-Google sync for the shared drives.
Nora L: tried incognito, same error. i don't have a YubiKey, using Windows Hello PIN as a platform authenticator.
Mina (IT): ok. Windows Hello sometimes fails if the FIDO metadata isn't available. can you run `reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography\Wintrust\Trust Providers\Software Publishing` and paste output? that helps rule out policy blocks.
Nora L: output pasted: "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Cryptography\Wintrust\Trust Providers\Software Publishing\State" = 0x0
Mina (IT): that looks fine. i'm seeing in our Okta logs that there was a mismatch between the device's origin and the expected RP ID due to a corp proxy header. two options: 1) enroll using the official enrollment link on the VPN or 2) we can temporarily enable the fallback SMS MFA and then attach 1Password and Drive. which do you prefer?
Nora L: prefer not to enable SMS if possible. i can jump on VPN.
Mina (IT): great — try the enrollment link https://okta.redwood.ai/webauthn-enroll while connected to our VPN and let me know. i'll also push a manual directory sync to propagate shared drive membership.
Ops-Bot: VPN session requested for Nora L. Link: https://vpn.redwood.ai/session/1942105678
Nora L: connected via VPN, re-run flow, touch Windows Hello, and it completed! Okta shows the passkey device.
Access-Bot: 1Password invite resent to nora.l@redwood.ai.
Mina (IT): syncing groups now, should be quick. note for ops: proxy was stripping Sec-Fetch-Site header causing RP id mismatch; filing infra ticket.
Hector (People Ops): thanks @Mina. Nora, once Drive shows up ping here and i'll make sure your buddy adds you to onboarding standups.
Nora L: Drive now shows 'Redwood > Eng' shared drive and i can open the onboarding folder. 1Password SSO works too. all good!
Mina (IT): closing the loop: enrollment succeeded over VPN; created INFRA-194210 to track proxy header issue; added a short troubleshooting note to #it-setup.
Hector (People Ops): welcome again Nora! reach out if anything else pops up.
Nora L: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick help. :smile:
